title: 非洲多国加强应对埃博拉疫情
title_en: African Countries Step Up Response to Ebola Outbreak
summary: 非洲多国加强应对埃博拉疫情。非洲疾控中心召开卫生部长高级别视频会议，推动加强监测、接触者追踪、感染防控和跨境协调。截至10月25日，刚果（金）累计确诊埃博拉病例10060例，死亡4887例，病死率48.6%，疫情波及8省，近期新增病例小幅上
summary_en: African countries are stepping up their response to the Ebola outbreak. The Africa CDC held a high-level virtual meeting of health ministers to strengthen surveillance, contact tracing, infection prevention and control, and cross-border coordination. As of Oct. 25, the Democratic Republic of the Congo had recorded 10,060 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,887 deaths, a case fatality rate of 48.6%, with the outbreak affecting eight provinces and recent new cases rising slightly.

summary_en: China's culture and tourism was showcased at the World Travel Market London. title_en: Uphold multilateral co-governance, jointly safeguard peace and tranquility in outer space
summary: 文章介绍中方在2026全球治理论坛（雄安）上提出《关于加强外空治理的中国立场》，旨在落实四大全球倡议，推动外空领域构建人类命运共同体。文件倡导外空发展与安全、稳定与可持续并重，秉持依规有序、全面综合、利益均衡、自我克制原则，并提出“三个坚持
summary_en: The article says China proposed 'China's Position on Strengthening Outer Space Governance' at the 2026 Global Governance Forum (Xiong'an), aiming to implement the four global initiatives and build a community with a shared future for mankind in outer space. The document advocates giving equal importance to development and security, stability and sustainability in outer space, following the principles of rule-based order, comprehensiveness, balanced interests and self-restraint, and puts forward 'three commitments'.

title: “赓续长征精神  奋进复兴征程——记者再走长征路”主题采访活动圆满结束
title_en: Themed reporting activity 'Carry forward the Long March spirit, forge ahead on the journey of rejuvenation—reporters retrace the Long March' concludes successfully
summary: 由中央宣传部组织开展的“赓续长征精神 奋进复兴征程——记者再走长征路”主题采访活动历时一个多月圆满结束。采访中，记者见证老区新变化，接受长征精神洗礼。江西瑞金至陕西延安高铁实现首次直达，开行首月发送旅客12.2万人次；湖南怀化依托国际陆港常
summary_en: The month-long themed interview activity 'Carrying Forward the Long March Spirit, Forging Ahead on the Journey to Rejuvenation — Journalists Retrace the Long March,' organized by the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee, concluded successfully. Journalists witnessed new changes in old revolutionary base areas and were inspired by the Long March spirit. The high-speed rail from Ruijin in Jiangxi to Yan'an in Shaanxi achieved direct service for the first time, carrying 122,000 passengers in its first month; Huaihua in Hunan, leveraging its international land port, has regularly launched international freight services.

summary_en: On Oct. 28, the 'Smart Connectivity · Innovation Sharing' China-South Korea Science and Technology Innovation Exchange Conference was held in Seoul. title: 夯实人才根基  蓄力网球未来
title_en: Strengthen Talent Base, Energize Tennis Future
summary: 国家体育总局网球运动管理中心主任白喜林介绍，中国网球正着力夯实后备人才根基。今年中国赛季本土选手表现突出，郑钦文夺得中网女单冠军，多名年轻小将刷新个人最佳；2026年中国赛季包含8站国际职业巡回赛和45站各类赛事，低级别、青少年赛事与顶级大
summary_en: Bai Xilin, director of the Tennis Management Center of the General Administration of Sport, said China is working to strengthen its tennis talent pipeline. This year Chinese players performed well in the China swing, with Zheng Qinwen winning the China Open women's singles title and several young players setting personal bests. The 2026 China swing will include 8 international professional tour events and 45 other tournaments, linking lower-level and junior events with top-level competitions.

title: 推广绿色建筑  提升城市品质（国际视点）
title_en: Promote Green Buildings, Enhance Urban Quality (International Perspective)
summary: 10月31日是世界城市日，建筑领域约占全球能源相关二氧化碳排放的1/3，推广绿色建筑成为提升城市品质的重要举措。文章介绍埃及、印度尼西亚、越南的实践：埃及发布“绿色金字塔”本土评级体系，大埃及博物馆获EDGE高级认证，新行政首都屋顶太阳能项
summary_en: Oct. 31 is World Cities Day. The building sector accounts for about one third of global energy-related CO2 emissions, and promoting green buildings has become an important measure to improve urban quality. The article examines practices in Egypt, Indonesia and Vietnam: Egypt issued its 'Green Pyramid' local rating system, the Grand Egyptian Museum obtained EDGE advanced certification, and rooftop solar projects in the new administrative capital are underway.

title: “让开放合作的蓝图成为看得见、摸得着的实景”

summary_en: The 9th CIIE opened on November 5, with 4,142 overseas enterprises exhibiting, total exhibition area exceeding 440,000 square meters for the first time, over 300 Fortune Global 500 and industry-leading companies participating, and multiple data hitting record highs. title: 跨境融通  赋能开放  交通银行亮相第九届中国国际进口博览会
title_en: Cross-border integration empowers opening-up; Bank of Communications makes debut at 9th CIIE
summary: 11月5日至10日，第九届中国国际进口博览会在上海举办。交通银行作为唯一总部在沪的中管金融机构和高级合作伙伴参展，300平方米展台创历届新高，以“跨境融通·助企扬帆”为主题，设离境退税、会客、主题活动、跨境金融成果、互动打卡五大板块。展区展
summary_en: From November 5 to 10, the 9th China International Import Expo will be held in Shanghai. Bank of Communications, the only centrally managed financial institution headquartered in Shanghai and a senior partner, will exhibit with a 300-square-meter booth, a record for the bank, under the theme 'Cross-border Connectivity · Helping Enterprises Set Sail,' featuring five sections: departure tax refund, guest reception, themed activities, cross-border financial achievements, and interactive check-in. The exhibition area displayed various financial services.

title: 潮起钱塘  世界回响 杭州推动文化“新三样”向海而行
title_en: As Qiantang River tide rises and echoes worldwide, Hangzhou promotes cultural 'new three items' going global
summary: 杭州推动以网文、网剧、网游为代表的文化“新三样”出海。《燕云十六声》获科隆游戏展最佳移动游戏奖，杭州AI竖屏剧入选戛纳电影节展映，《黑神话：悟空》音乐会走进纽约。2025年杭州文化“新三样”规上企业营收2011亿元，占浙江超80%，覆盖海外
summary_en: Hangzhou is promoting the overseas expansion of the cultural 'new three types' — online literature, web dramas, and online games. 'Where Winds Meet' won Best Mobile Game at Gamescom; Hangzhou's AI vertical-screen drama was selected for screening at the Cannes Film Festival; and the 'Black Myth: Wukong' concert performed in New York. In 2025, revenue of Hangzhou's cultural 'new three types' enterprises above designated size reached 201.1 billion yuan, accounting for more than 80% of Zhejiang's total, covering overseas markets.

summary: 阿富汗卡迪尔·拉尔夫有限公司连续参加中国国际进口博览会，是进博会“全勤生”。公司负责人哈默德·拉尔夫介绍，受益于中方给予阿富汗100%税目产品零关税待遇和进博会平台，阿富汗手工地毯在中国市场销量快速增长，公司营业额自首届进博会以来增长近70
summary_en: Afghanistan's Qadir Ralf Ltd. has attended every China International Import Expo, making it a 'full-attendance' exhibitor. Company head Hamed Ralf said that thanks to China's zero-tariff treatment on 100% of Afghan products and the CIIE platform, sales of Afghan handmade carpets have grown rapidly in the Chinese market, and the company's revenue has increased by nearly 70% since the first CIIE.

title: 共同擘画新时代中多命运共同体的美好蓝图（大使随笔）
title_en: Jointly drawing a beautiful blueprint for a China-Togo community with a shared future in the new era (Ambassador's Journal)
summary: 10月，习近平主席在北京会见多哥部长会议主席福雷，双方宣布将双边关系定位提升为新时代中多命运共同体，发表联合声明并签署15项合作协议。建交54年来，中多始终相互尊重、团结协作，多哥坚定恪守一个中国原则，支持人类命运共同体理念和全球倡议。习近
summary_en: In October, President Xi Jinping met with Togo's Prime Minister Faure in Beijing. The two sides announced the elevation of bilateral relations to a China-Togo community with a shared future in the new era, issued a joint statement, and signed 15 cooperation agreements. Over 54 years of diplomatic relations, China and Togo have always respected each other and worked together; Togo firmly adheres to the One-China principle and supports the concept of a community with a shared future for mankind and global initiatives.
